newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka bourse evacuated briefly for fire drill.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka bourse evacuated briefly for fire drill.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Colombo was evacuated briefly on Thursday morning for a fire drill, brokers said.
The evacuation began around 0400 GMT and lasted for about 15 minutes, a stock exchange official told Reuters.
"It was just a drill," said the official, who declined to be identified.
Brokers said the evacuation had come without notice and some had believed it was a real emergency.
"It was so quick, we didn't even have time to shut down, which meant there was hardly any interruption to trading," said one broker.
